<?php
const KANA_TABLE = [
     'わをん',
 'あいうえお', 'かきくけこ', 'さしすせそ',
     'たちつてと', 'なにぬねの', 'はひふへほ',
     'まみむめも',  'やゆよ',      'らりるれろ',
];
while (($s = fgets(STDIN)) !== false) {
    $s = trim($s);
    $result = '';
    $i = 0;
    $len = strlen($s);
    while ($i < $len) {
        $key = $s[$i];
        $count = 0;
        while ($i < $len && $s[$i] === $key) {
            $count++;
            $i++;
        }
        $chars = KANA_TABLE[(int)$key];
        $idx = ($count - 1) % mb_strlen($chars);
        $result .= mb_substr($chars, $idx, 1);
    }
    echo $result . "\n";
}
